title: 第二十章 无妨第二十一章 愣头青
lines: 第二十章无妨
“那我就提前感谢你了。”黄德平笑着说道，也没放在心上。
叶欢说的是有缘，也就是不一定有，这茶说得如此神异，怎么可能说有就有。
“我的事情办好了吗？”叶欢也不再茶树上纠缠，若是以后寻到了灵茶，再送给黄德平就是。
“你真的确定了吗？要到林城大学去授课，还是物理专业？林城大学可是全国前30的大学，你如果乱来的话……”
黄德平有些担忧，虽然叶欢很强，也很奇特，没有失手过。
但那是在武力方面，没听说那个格斗高手还是学习天才的。
人，终究不是神！不可能所有的东西都擅长！
可这是叶欢明确地要求，黄德平知道，叶欢冲着那颗能量石去的，是去找刘玉权教授。
可是叶欢对北山军区有大恩，可以说是无私奉献，不求回报，他无法拒绝叶欢的要求。
“相信我，大学物理我知道，教一群普通的大学生还是绰绰有余的。”叶欢自信地说道。
黄德平有些无语，无论干什么，叶欢总是这样傲气十足的样子。
可是人家的确有真本事，让黄德平震惊也不是一次两次了。
“那好，我都已经安排好了，林城大学的客座教授。本来教育部的事情我是管不着的，还好还有些老兄弟，在教育系统工作，卖我个面子，给你个客座教授的身份。”
客座教授不是真正教育系统的职称，属于名誉教授，一般是由明星，社会名人之类的担任。
不过没有那个会去担任物理学院的客座教授原因很简单，哪个明星会很了解物理，还能去给大学生讲课。
“那好，我现在就去林城中学。”
叶欢一刻也不想耽误，因为训练龙腾，他已经浪费一个月时间了。
其实也不算浪费，叶欢利用这一个月时间，巩固了一下修为。
虽然还是炼气中期，但灵气浓度而言，应该相当于中级战将了。
当然，叶欢自信，他的真实实力，肯定比一般中级战将要强！
“现在？”黄德平没想到叶欢这么急。
“嗯，马上就离开。”
叶欢直接起身。
“等等，入伍的事情真的不再考虑一下吗？”
黄德平叫住了叶欢，做最后的挽留，“作为龙腾的教官，我可以给你上校的军衔，加上龙腾现在如此之强，日后立功了你还能晋升！”
“而且，你不必一直带着军中。我可以保证，给你最大的自由权限，你可以去做自己想做的事情。”
叶欢是个人才，太强大了，就在军中必然会有大作为的。
他也是惜才，舍不得放叶欢离开。
“谢了。”叶欢摇摇头，“今生我也不会加入任何组织的，帮我安排一辆车，送我到机场吧。”
叶欢是修真者，他怎么可能加入军队，即便是挂名也不行。
这种东西，承担了就得负责任，叶欢完全没有要为国家或者军队负责的想法。
他现在最大的希望，就是修炼，疯狂的修炼。
他必须要在身体衰老之前，修炼到入圣境，这样，他才能离开地球！
叶欢没有什么东西收拾，就一个背包，还有小狼。
经过一个月的喂养，小狼的身材虽然没有变化，但是叶欢能够感受到，它的实力提升了。
content_en:
Chapter 20 It doesn’t matter
"Then I'll thank you in advance." Huang Deping said with a smile and didn't take it to heart.
Ye Huan is talking about destiny, which means it may not exist. This tea is so magical, how can it be said that it exists?
"Have my affairs been done?" Ye Huan no longer bothered with the tea tree. If he found spiritual tea in the future, he would give it to Huang Deping.
"Are you really sure? Are you going to Lincheng University to teach, or are you going to major in physics? Lincheng University is one of the top 30 universities in the country. If you mess around..."
Huang Deping was a little worried. Although Ye Huan was very strong and unique, he had never failed.
But that's in terms of force. I haven't heard that the fighting master is a genius at learning.
Humans are not gods after all! It’s impossible to be good at everything!
But this was Ye Huan's clear request. Huang Deping knew that Ye Huan went to find Professor Liu Yuquan for the energy stone.
However, Ye Huan was very kind to the Beishan Military Region. It could be said that it was a selfless contribution without asking for anything in return. He could not refuse Ye Huan's request.
"Believe me, I know that college physics is more than enough to teach a group of ordinary college students." Ye Huan said confidently.
Huang Deping was speechless. No matter what he did, Ye Huan always looked so arrogant.
But he does have real abilities, and Huang Deping was shocked not once or twice.
"Well, I have already made arrangements for you to be a visiting professor at Lincheng University. Originally, I had no control over the affairs of the Ministry of Education. Fortunately, there are some old brothers who work in the education system and gave me the honor of giving you the status of a visiting professor."
Visiting professor is not a professional title in the real education system, but an honorary professor. It is usually held by celebrities, celebrities and the like.
But there is no one who will serve as a visiting professor in the School of Physics. The reason is simple. Which celebrity knows physics well and can also give lectures to college students.
"Okay, I'll go to Lincheng Middle School now."
Ye Huan didn't want to waste a moment because he had already wasted a month training Long Teng.
In fact, it was not a waste. Ye Huan used this month to consolidate his cultivation.
Although he is still in the middle stage of Qi refining, in terms of spiritual energy concentration, he should be equivalent to an intermediate warrior.
Of course, Ye Huan is confident that his true strength is definitely stronger than the average mid-level warrior!
"Now?" Huang Deping didn't expect Ye Huan to be so anxious.
"Well, leave right away."
Ye Huan stood up directly.
"Wait a minute, are you really not thinking about enlisting in the army anymore?"
Huang Deping stopped Ye Huan and made a final effort to persuade him to stay, "As Long Teng's instructor, I can give you the rank of colonel. Plus Long Teng is so strong now, you can be promoted in the future if you perform meritorious service!"
"Moreover, you don't have to be in the military all the time. I can guarantee that I will give you the greatest freedom and you can do what you want."
Ye Huan is a talented person, so powerful that he will definitely achieve great things in the army.
He also cherished his talent and was reluctant to let Ye Huan leave.
"Thank you." Ye Huan shook his head, "I will not join any organization in this life. Help me arrange a car to take me to the airport."
Ye Huan is a cultivator, how could he join the army, even in name only.
If you take on this kind of thing, you have to be responsible. Ye Huan has no idea of ​​being responsible for the country or the army.
His biggest hope now is to practice, practice like crazy.
He must cultivate to the holy realm before his body ages, so that he can leave the earth!
Ye Huan didn't have much to pack, just a backpack and Little Wolf.
After a month of feeding, although the little wolf's figure had not changed, Ye Huan could feel that its strength had improved.
